mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS change and SPX 20d returns is not positive and significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic weakness and potential corporate earnings deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the average 20d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and real GDP growth indicates a broad economic slowdown, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or the joint effect is not significant (p>0.05 in a regression of returns on the interaction term).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the average 60d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates strong economic growth and corporate hiring, which supports earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises, or the correlation between PAYEMS change and SPX 5d returns is not positive and significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the average 20d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint effect is not significant (p>0.05 in a regression of returns on the interaction term).

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% annualized), robust economic growth supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized, or the average 60d return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).
